UPSTREAM: mainboard/google/reef: remove internal pullups on PP1800_S rail The PP1800_S rail is turned off in S3. However, enabling internal pullups on the pins which are connected to PP1800_S results in leakage into the P1800_S rail. Fix this by disabling the internal pullups on PP1800_S rail pins. BUG=chrome-os-partner:61968 BRANCH=reef TEST=measured leakage on PP1800_S rail. Gone with this patch. CHROMIUM: drm: bridge/analogix: move fast link training detect to set_bridge It's too early to detect fast link training, if other step after it failed, we will set fast_link flag to 1, and retry set_bridge again. In this case we will power down and power up panel power supply, and we will do fast link training since we have set fast_link flag to 1. In fact, we should do full link training now, not the fast link training. So we should move the fast link detection at the end of set_bridge. BUG=chrome-os-partner:60130 TEST="suspend_stress_test" Change-Id: I3e8f08fa46391aefe031e58d7559ee6b3fe9b122 Signed-off-by: zain wang <wzz@rock-chips.com> Signed-off-by: Douglas Anderson <dianders@chromium.org> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/427525 Commit-Ready: 征增 王 <wzz@rock-chips.com> Tested-by: 征增 王 <wzz@rock-chips.com> Reviewed-by: Tomasz Figa <tfiga@chromium.org>
